stem:
A student produces a labeled drawing of a virus for a presentation. The student states that the capsid has a function similar to the nuclear membrane found in animal cells.

Which of these describes the similar functions of capsids and nuclear membranes?

options.label: A
options.text: Both transport proteins throughout the structures.

options.label: B
options.text: Both provide energy for activities in the structures.

options.label: C
options.text: Both protect genetic information for the structures.

options.label: D
options.text: Both code for the proteins needed for reproduction of the structures.

visual_elements: Virus Structure diagram with labels Capsid and DNA
